name: GhoulxCards
storyline: You wake in the basement of the Rusty Flagon with a worn deck in your hands. Upstairs, the Tavern is the hub for everything: head out its door into the Adventure maps, or set off in Story mode to explore Hollowbrook and the lands beyond, with towns to visit, duelists to beat, quests to finish and creatures to tame.
summary: GhoulxCards is a free card game made for Twitch communities. Viewers earn card packs from the streamers they watch: by checking in with channel points every stream, beating bosses, and raiding together with chat. Every streamer has their own set of cards, with custom art and names. Build a deck and take it through Adventure maps, harder Hell Mode and El Diablo runs, the Endless Gullet, a two-player co-op map, and Story mode. When a streamer goes live, their whole chat can fight a raid boss together, and everyone who wins takes home packs. Streamers get a dashboard, their own custom cards, stream alerts and a Tavern shop of their own. The GhoulxCards Twitch extension adds a panel under the stream where viewers send Bits sound alerts, earn loyalty on the channel and show off their character.
